articles.summary: The EC opened an investigation into practices related to a non-solicitation agreement between two major manufacturing technology companies. A CRA team including Mikaël Hervé, Chara Tzanetaki, Mariam Arutyunyan, and David Meijer advised one of the companies during the European Commission’s investigation. The team analysed the rationale and the effects of the non-solicit obligation, providing a […]
articles.title: CRA successfully assisted client in EC antitrust investigation in tech labour markets
